artifacts.summary: Re-confirms the four measured carried-figure failure sub-classes against the Logos/Verification consumer repo and rules on all four scope items: where the contract lives (report-format.md states fully, plan-format.md points), the carried-figure trigger definition, the CARRIED-UNVERIFIED mark, and internal-consistency check feasibility (narrow check feasible, general case infeasible with a reviewer prompt).

memory_candidates.content: plan-format.md already has a 'Counts-are-hypotheses obligation' (Scope Hypothesis field) governing a plan's OWN forward-looking count/scope estimates, requiring implementation-time confirmation. This is a distinct concept from a figure COPIED from another already-written record into a new report/plan (carried-figure discipline) -- the two are complementary, not duplicates, and a new carried-figure contract should cross-reference rather than merge into Scope Hypothesis.

context/contracts/adversarial-verification.md already establishes a bolded VERIFIED/UNVERIFIED and UNRESOLVED CONTRADICTION: marker style, but it is gated to hard-mode (H4) research agents only -- it is not part of the base report-format.md/plan-format.md. A new always-active marker convention (e.g. CARRIED-UNVERIFIED) should borrow this family's uppercase/bold/grep-friendly style without depending on hard-mode gating, since the defect it addresses was not hard-mode-specific.
